text:
Ivy Nguyen: Kaldera Ops sent invoice KAL-554 for $5,120 but the PDF names "Kaldera EU" and no PO is present. Vendor says they'll suspend monitoring if unpaid in 7 days.
Carlos Mendez: Invoice number and vendor ref?
Ivy Nguyen: KAL-554, ref KEU-4421. Line items: alerting license, agent support, cross-region egress credits.
Ruth Allen: That should be on PO-9404 (Ops tooling). Procurement confirms PO exists in USD under Redwood Inc, not Kaldera EU.
Samir Patel: Coupa auto-match failed due to missing PO and entity mismatch. APBot flagged it: NO_PO_MATCH + ENTITY_MISMATCH.
APBot: Invoice KAL-554 flagged. Status: PAYMENT_HOLD. AP ticket AP-55612 created. Required approvers: Carlos Mendez (Ops owner), Samir Patel (FP&A), Tax team if EU entity stays.
Ivy Nguyen: Vendor offered to reissue in 24h but wants immediate payment to avoid downtime. They can accept wire/ACH now but need billing name fixed for records.
Carlos Mendez: I can approve the functional charge to avoid service impact, but we need Tax sign-off before processing since vendor billed EU entity (VAT risk).
TaxBot: Tax note: if vendor invoices Kaldera EU we may have VAT/withholding exposure. Need vendor to reissue to Redwood Inc. If not, Tax requires EU VAT docs and will advise on reclaim handling.
Samir Patel: Cash available; FP&A ok with one-time override provided vendor reissues within 5 business days and AP adds memo "vendor billed wrong entity; reissue requested".
Ruth Allen: I'll ask vendor to reissue to Redwood Inc with PO-9404. If they can't, we proceed with conditional payment and Tax-led reconciliation.
APBot: Approvals recorded: Ops owner + FP&A. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared. Payment scheduled on 2026-06-01 run. Follow-up action: Procurement to confirm vendor billing contact updated and Tax to add reconciliation plan to AP-55612.
Ivy Nguyen: Thanks — I'll confirm with Kaldera and attach the reissued invoice or EU tax docs to AP-55612. Marking for follow-up after payment posts.
